process_multimodal_with_mimo_omni: call MiMoOmniProcessor to process text with images, videos, and audio into model-ready tensors
build_processor_from_hf_config: build a MiMoOmniProcessor instance from a HuggingFace model config using the from_hf_config class method
process_image_with_mimo_vl: use MiMoVLProcessor.process_image to preprocess a PIL image into a normalized tensor for the model
process_video_with_mimo_vl: use MiMoVLProcessor.process_video to preprocess video frames and timestamps into flattened visual patches
preprocess_audio_with_mimo_vl: use MiMoVLProcessor.preprocess_audio to decode audio and compute mel-spectrogram features with token length
